 "data": "graph TD
 %% SUBGRAPH: FRONTEND & GATEWAY
 subgraph FRONTEND [\"1. Frontend & API Gateway Layer\"]
 UI[\"index_llm.html<br/>• TradingView Charts<br/>• Real-Time SSE Terminal\"]
 GATEWAY[\"slim_app2.py (FastAPI)<br/>• POST /api/analyze<br/>• GET /api/chart_data\"]
 end

 %% SUBGRAPH: AGENT CORE LOGIC
 subgraph ORCHESTRATION [\"2. Agent Orchestration & Core Logic\"]
 AGENT[\"agent5_async.py<br/>• AgentOrchestrator<br/>• Async ReAct Loop\"]
 SYNTHESIS[\"llm_synthesis.py<br/>• LLMRouter<br/>• Provider Fallbacks\"]
 PROMPTS[\"prompt_manager.py<br/>• System Prompts<br/>• Code Gen Templates\"]
 SCHEMA[\"schema_layer.py<br/>• Pydantic Contracts<br/>• Output Validation\"]
 end

 %% SUBGRAPH: SANDBOX & ANALYTICS
 subgraph COMPUTATION [\"3. Computation & Sandbox Engine\"]
 ANALYTICAL[\"analytical_engine.py<br/>• RSI, MACD, MA20/50<br/>• Bollinger Bands\"]
 SANDBOX[\"sandbox_engine.py<br/>• Isolated exec Environment<br/>• Base64 Plot Interceptor\"]
 end

 %% SUBGRAPH: PERSISTENCE & PIPELINE
 subgraph PERSISTENCE [\"4. Data Persistence & Pipeline Layer\"]
 PIPELINE[\"market_pipeline.py<br/>• yFinance Data Aggregator<br/>• DB Fusion Engine\"]
 SQL_DB[(\"SQLite DB & Parquet<br/>• fused_database5.db<br/>• stock_cache_fin4.parquet\")]
 CHROMA_DB[(\"ChromaDB Vector Store<br/>• chroma_research_db<br/>• RAG Context Embeddings\")]
 end

 %% SUBGRAPH: EXTERNAL SERVICES
 subgraph EXTERNAL [\"5. External Providers & Infrastructure\"]
 LLM_APIS[\"LLM Cloud APIs<br/>• Groq (Llama 3.3)<br/>• Anthropic (Claude 3.5)<br/>• OpenAI\"]
 SCRAPERS[\"Data Scrapers & APIs<br/>• yFinance API<br/>• Web Search\"]
 CONTAINER[\"Container Runtime<br/>• Dockerfile / Docker Compose<br/>• HF Spaces @spaces.GPU\"]
 end

 %% CONNECTIONS & FLOWS
 UI -->|1. SSE Request| GATEWAY
 GATEWAY -->|2. Dispatch Query| AGENT
 AGENT -->|3. Load Prompts| PROMPTS
 AGENT -->|4. Validate Schemas| SCHEMA
 AGENT -->|5. Multi-Turn Routing| SYNTHESIS
 SYNTHESIS -->|6. Inference Request| LLM_APIS
 
 AGENT -->|7. Technical Calculations| ANALYTICAL
 AGENT -->|8. Run Dynamic Python Code| SANDBOX
 
 PIPELINE -->|Fetch Scrapes| SCRAPERS
 PIPELINE -->|Write Metrics| SQL_DB
 PIPELINE -->|Embed News| CHROMA_DB
 
 SANDBOX -->|Read Data| SQL_DB
 AGENT -->|RAG Vector Retrieval| CHROMA_DB",
